title: IGAD Flood Impact Assessment Layers
description: Daily flood impact assessment layers showing potential impacts on built environment and agricultural areas (cropland). These vector layers provide detailed impact analysis for disaster response and recovery planning across the IGAD region.

providers.name: IGAD Climate Prediction and Applications Centre (ICPAC)

built_impacts.title: Built Environment Impact Shapefile
built_impacts.description: Polygon features showing flood impacts on built/urban areas

cropland_impacts.title: Cropland Impact Shapefile
cropland_impacts.description: Polygon features showing flood impacts on agricultural areas
